Join our team

We are a small software company in Bern and we are looking for people who enjoy building reliable products. You will work on our platform with the rest of the team, and you will talk to our customers every week to understand what they need from us.

If you are interested in the role, send us your resume and a short note about the projects you are most proud of. We read every application and we will answer within two weeks.
